definitions: The visible shape or configuration of something.
A particular way in which a thing exists, acts, or manifests itself.
A printed document with blank spaces for information to be inserted.
A class or year group in a school.
The state of an athlete or horse with regard to fitness or performance.
examples: The trees were dark forms against the sky.
Please fill in the application form.
He is in the sixth form.
The striker is currently in good form.
